title: Finite split coefficient algebra before maximal localization
statement: Let $R$ be a normal Nagata domain [def-weil-pbc-normal-ring] [def-weil-pbc-nagata-ring], $K$ its fraction field, $x\in K$, the subalgebra $S$ generated by $x$ over $R$, and $m$ a maximal ideal of $S$. There exist $s\in S\setminus m$, a normal Nagata domain $R'$ with fraction field $K'$, $z\in K'$, and an injective finite ring map $g:S_s\to T$, where $T$ is generated by $z$ over $R'$ [def-weil-pbc-module-localization-away] [def-weil-finitely-generated-module], together with a monic polynomial $f$ over $R'$ of positive degree which splits over $R'$. Its evaluation at $z$, viewed in $T$, belongs to the extension of $m$ along $S\to S_s\to T$. The rings $R'$ and $K'$ are in $\mathrm{Type}(\max(u,v))$ for $R$ and $K$ in universes $u,v$. No maximal localization or maximal contraction assertion is included.

source.place: Tag 0334, proposition-nagata-universally-japanese, Step 5: residue-polynomial lifting, finite splitting extension, integral closure and roots over maximal ideals

proof.text: Apply the monogenic residue polynomial model to get s outside m, a normal Nagata A with fraction field L in universe max(u,v), y, e:S_s -> A[y], and a monic positive-degree relation with evaluation in the extended ideal.

Apply the finite splitting construction to A,L,y and the already extended ideal. Compose its injective finite map g with e. Injectivity composes, and g.Finite.comp e.finite supplies finiteness. Ideal.map_map and RingHom.comp_assoc identify the resulting extension of m with the target ideal. Package the ring structures, Nagata proof and split polynomial unchanged.

theorem exists_adjoin_singleton_finite_split_algebra
    (R : Type u) (K : Type v) [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [IsIntegrallyClosed R]
    [Field K] [Algebra R K] [IsFractionRing R K] (hR : IsNagataRing R) (x : K)
    (m : Ideal (Algebra.adjoin R ({x} : Set K))) [m.IsMaximal] :
    ∃ (s : Algebra.adjoin R ({x} : Set K)), s ∉ m ∧
      ∃ (R' K' : Type (max u v)) (_ : CommRing R') (_ : IsDomain R')
        (_ : IsIntegrallyClosed R') (_ : Field K') (_ : Algebra R' K')
        (_ : IsFractionRing R' K'),
        IsNagataRing R' ∧ ∃ (z : K')
          (g : Localization.Away s →+* Algebra.adjoin R' ({z} : Set K')),
          Function.Injective g ∧ g.Finite ∧ ∃ f : Polynomial R',
            f.Monic ∧ 0 < f.natDegree ∧ f.Splits ∧
            Polynomial.aeval
              (⟨z, Algebra.subset_adjoin (Set.mem_singleton z)⟩ :
                Algebra.adjoin R' ({z} : Set K')) f ∈
              m.map (g.comp (algebraMap _ (Localization.Away s)))
